subject.title: fix(plugins): report missing config clearly instead of misleading required-property errors

question: Should the post-ready validation path be corrected by carrying resolved plugin config forward, or is bounded deduplication intentionally preferred for repeated identical diagnostics?
rationale: The PR and tests do not identify the lifecycle owner of the repeated validation, and choosing between correcting the input path and suppressing repeated output affects runtime ownership and observability.

options.title: Propagate resolved config
options.body: Trace the repeated caller and pass its already-resolved canonical plugin config into validation, reserving deduplication for any intentionally repeated checks.

options.title: Add bounded deduplication
options.body: Keep the repeated validation but suppress identical diagnostics with an explicitly lifecycle-owned and tested deduplication policy.

recommendation.title: Propagate resolved config
recommendation.body: Trace the repeated caller and pass its already-resolved canonical plugin config into validation, reserving deduplication for any intentionally repeated checks.

likelyOwner.reason: This reviewer already articulated both acceptable redesign directions and the invariants required for another review.
